metadata_system.name: HEIF / HEIC Metadata
metadata_system.spec_source: ISO/IEC 23008-12 (HEIF) + ISO/IEC 14496-12 (ISOBMFF) + GPAC source (388 box types extracted)
metadata_system.description: HEIF (High Efficiency Image File Format) is the ISO/IEC 23008-12 container format used by Apple for .HEIC photos since iOS 11 (2017) and adopted by AVIF (.avif) for AV1-coded stills. The container is built on ISOBMFF (the same base as MP4/MOV) and uses a hierarchical box structure. An image is stored as one or more 'items' inside a 'meta' box, with item locations, types, references, and properties tracked in dedicated boxes. This entry catalogs all 388 ISOBMFF/HEIF box types from GPAC's reference implementation, plus all standard properties, brands, item types, color information enums, item-reference types, and Apple-specific Live Photo extensions.
